title: Top nav section links work from /beta
description:
From https://chattic.us/beta#top, Organization / Why Chatticus / Evidence / FAQ stay on /beta with a hash that has no matching section. The wordmark is labeled Chatticus home but `href="#top"` is also page-local, so it does not leave /beta.

Confirmed on production: clicking Organization changes the URL to https://chattic.us/beta#organization and the page does not move to the home Organization section.

Root cause: `web/components/Header.tsx` uses in-page hashes (`#organization`, `#control`, `#evidence`, `#faq`, `#top`). Those ids exist only on the home page (`Hero` has `id="top"`, `OrganizationStory` has `id="organization"`). The same Header is mounted on /beta, /contact/*, /features/*, and waitlist confirm/invite.

DoD:
- From /beta (including /beta#top), each top-nav section link lands on the matching home-page section.
- The wordmark labeled Chatticus home leaves /beta for the marketing home page.
- One path: root-relative home hashes (`/#organization`), not a page-local vs home-page dual.
- Footer "Back to the top" may stay page-local if that is current-page scroll; do not conflate it with Chatticus home.
- Behavior in Gherkin, not a pytest/source-scan for the click path.

```gherkin
Feature: Marketing primary navigation

  Scenario: section links from the beta page reach home page sections
    Given a visitor on the beta pitch page
    When they follow the Organization link in the primary navigation
    Then they are on the home page Organization section
```
